question: A sodium street lamp emits yellow light of wavelength $589\,\text{nm}$ in air. This light enters a glass slab of refractive index $n=1.5$ and thickness $2.0\,\text{cm}$ normally. Taking $c=3.0\times10^8\,\text{m/s}$, determine (i) the time taken by the wave to cross the slab and (ii) the number of complete oscillations of the electric field that occur during this transit.
